subject: peacock butterfly (Aglais io), a single butterfly as a pinned museum specimen seen from directly above, both pairs of wings spread fully open and perfectly flat in one plane, symmetrical, head at the top, slender dark body down the middle, two thin antennae: deep rusty red wings with a dark brown rim, one large eyespot near the tip of each of the four wings, the forewing eyespots ringed yellow, blue and black, the hindwing eyespots blue and black ringed pale
